answer: Mechanism: Threshold-VRF epoch admission with post-pulse proof-of-retrieval. Agents commit ephemeral keys before a drand pulse. The pulse seeds a threshold BLS VRF that selects a random mesa committee and reef data shards per identity; selected agents must fetch/prove those shards within one slot. Since the pulse is unpredictable until broadcast, Sybils cannot precompute winners or pre-fetch reef shards. To scale, an attacker must keep every identity online with storage/bandwidth for arbitrary shards and pay failed-proof penalties per epoch, making cost linear in live identities.
